intent: To demonstrate the low survival rate of family businesses across generations.

units.meaning: The second-generation survival share for family businesses is 33.3% — about one in three.

basis.entity: family businesses that survive the second generation
family businesses that survive the second generation

accepted_routes: Only about a third of family businesses survive the second generation.
Roughly one in three make it to the second generation.
units.visual_evidence_rule: A donut/ring chart must visibly mark one segment as 33.3% or 0.333 for second-generation survival.
units.temporal_anchor: First clause: 'Only about a third of family businesses survive the second generation'.
units.reviewer_question: Must the exact 33.3% value be shown, or is an approximate one-in-three wording sufficient?

units.meaning: The complement of the 33.3% survival share is 66.7%, so most family businesses do not survive to the second generation.

basis.entity: family businesses that survive the second generation

accepted_routes: About two thirds do not survive to the second generation.
units.visual_evidence_rule: The complement of the highlighted 33.3% segment must be visible as 66.7% or as the remaining unhighlighted portion of the donut.
units.temporal_anchor: First clause: 'Only about a third of family businesses survive the second generation'.
units.reviewer_question: Must the video explicitly show the 66.7% complement, or is highlighting only the 33.3% survival slice enough?

optional_valid: The 33.3% survival share can be described as about one in three.
The 33.3% is the only table-supported survival figure for this clip.
The ring may de-emphasise the 66.7% remainder while highlighting the survival arc.
unsupported_to_avoid: The 50% figure for not lasting until the third generation; that belongs to the paired clip.
Any third-generation or fourth-generation survival value.
Raw counts of family businesses instead of the share.
Causal explanations for why family businesses fail.
Claiming the table proves exactly 33.3%; the narration says about a third.
notes: 旁白 "about a third"，环上弧长 33.3%，按旁白取 33.3%；补数 66.7%，差 33.4 个百分点。
